blocks.text:
**Group departure:** 05.02 - 16.02  

The trip is built around the contrast between two parts. In Rio, the days are filled with excursions, city panoramas and Carnival events. The journey then continues to the coast, where there is no compulsory daily programme. After the Sambadrome and several early starts, this gives you the chance to spend the rest of the tour at a much more relaxed pace.

The trip has two full parts. The first focuses on the city and Carnival, and the second on a peaceful coastal holiday. Angra dos Reis therefore accounts for seven nights and is a separate stage of the journey, rather than a short addition after Rio.
